title: when-who: code for “Why pooled and per-patient scores of repeated clinical forecasts both mislead, and how to fix them”
description: The withinpatient Python package and its R port, the simulations, the cohort analyses, and the scripts that produce every table and figure of the paper “Why pooled and per-patient scores of repeated clinical forecasts both mislead, and how to fix them”.
